description: This file contains a JUnit test class for testing the AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanup class, focusing on persistence cleanup, snapshot handling, and failure scenarios in an Akka Persistence context.

classes.name: AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanupTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanup, including cleanup, snapshot, and failure scenarios.

classes.name: DummyPersistentActor
classes.description: A test double extending AbstractPersistentActorWithTimersAndCleanup simulating persistence behavior with snapshot management and message persistence.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests.

methods.name: testDeleteSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful deletion and cleanup of persisted messages.

methods.description: Tests failure scenario when message deletion fails.

methods.description: Ensures cleanup is skipped if the entity's revision hasn't changed.

methods.name: testDeleteIsCalledWhenRevisionChanged
